cost_by_trigger.local: Seconds to a few minutes; invoked explicitly or through a named profile.
cost_by_trigger.ci: Bounded by the ordinary just ci job budget and reported by that workflow.
cost_by_trigger.manual: Potentially model- and network-expensive; never runs implicitly or joins just ci.
cost_by_trigger.release: Network-dependent and run only during candidate or publication reconciliation.

owner_by_kind.command: The version-neutral xtask module implementing the command; release adapters own composition only.
owner_by_kind.workflow: The tracked workflow file and its invoked version-neutral command or observational runner.
owner_by_kind.protocol: The tracked protocol plus its observational runner; no product-state owner.

lifecycle_rules.permanent: Maintained with ordinary CI and changed with its owning feature.
lifecycle_rules.release_scoped: Frozen after publication except for a demonstrated correctness repair.
lifecycle_rules.post_merge: Run after merge when evidence exists, retain as a workflow artifact, then freeze with the release.

entries.conclusion: The selected named check composition completed.
entries.does_not_establish: That unselected checks or external systems are correct.

entries.conclusion: The tracked RFC and ADR structure, pinned publications, review records, vectors, and formal obligations pass as one repository profile.
entries.does_not_establish: A hermetic result when its declared external reads are unavailable, or that a design is desirable or implemented.

entries.conclusion: Pinned RFC publication claims resolve through a fresh clone and real kan and match their normative sources.
entries.does_not_establish: Availability or correctness beyond the pinned publication coordinates and kan compatibility floor.

entries.conclusion: The implementation agrees with the checked process-model vectors supplied in the repository.
entries.does_not_establish: Conformance beyond the vector corpus.

entries.conclusion: The formal companion checks its declared properties over the supplied tracked bytes.
entries.does_not_establish: Correctness outside the formal model and assumptions.

entries.conclusion: Instrumentation surfaces have exhaustive declared boundaries.
entries.does_not_establish: That each instrument proves more than its declared conclusion.

entries.conclusion: Review records satisfy the repository review schema.
entries.does_not_establish: That the review judgment is correct.

entries.conclusion: Addressed behavior differs across the selected revisions.
entries.does_not_establish: A causal or universal behavioral claim.

entries.conclusion: One declared mutation is detected by its harness.
entries.does_not_establish: Completeness against other mutations.

entries.conclusion: The addressed change is necessary for the selected harness result.
entries.does_not_establish: That it is sufficient for the whole release.

entries.conclusion: Changed production surfaces are demonstrated or explicitly exempted.
entries.does_not_establish: That demonstrations cover all semantic behavior.

entries.conclusion: Review findings are accounted for by the selected range.
entries.does_not_establish: That no undiscovered finding exists.

entries.conclusion: The v0.13 release manifest equals its thin typed composition.
entries.does_not_establish: The behavior or authenticity of referenced systems.

entries.conclusion: The selected Plan resolves to its exact tracked artifact.
entries.does_not_establish: That every Plan requirement is satisfied.

entries.conclusion: Four deterministic candidate workflows succeeded at one clean SHA.
entries.does_not_establish: Observational trial quality or resistance to a malicious producer.

entries.conclusion: Tag, release workflow, crate, GitHub Release, and kan Result reconcile to one SHA.
entries.does_not_establish: Behavior beyond the qualified candidate.

entries.conclusion: The repository CI profile passes.
entries.does_not_establish: External compatibility outside declared jobs.

entries.conclusion: Declared agent plugin packages pass their integration checks.
entries.does_not_establish: All host or future plugin compatibility.

entries.conclusion: The declared kan compatibility matrix passes.
entries.does_not_establish: Compatibility outside the declared versions.

entries.conclusion: Declared migration paths pass their matrix.
entries.does_not_establish: Arbitrary historical repository migration.

entries.conclusion: A named clean host produced retained adoption-path observations.
entries.does_not_establish: Universal install reliability or a source-candidate pass.

entries.conclusion: A named harness produced retained legible-surface evaluation material.
entries.does_not_establish: Universal human comprehension or adversarial producer resistance.

entries.conclusion: Tracked nudge declarations satisfy the catalog checks.
entries.does_not_establish: That every nudge is effective for every user or host.

entries.conclusion: Changed commits with demonstration trailers re-derive their scoped revert result.
entries.does_not_establish: Completeness against behavior outside each declared test scope.

entries.conclusion: A named model produced retained raw interactions for the preregistered scenarios.
entries.does_not_establish: A deterministic pass, universal model behavior, or malicious-producer resistance.

entries.conclusion: A fresh session produced retained wakeup output against an addressed evidence checkout.
entries.does_not_establish: Cryptographic truth of narrative claims or malicious-producer resistance.

entries.conclusion: Release artifacts were published from the selected candidate.
entries.does_not_establish: Semantic correctness beyond candidate qualification.

entries.conclusion: The same named interaction scenarios can be replayed and inspected.
entries.does_not_establish: An authoritative behavioral grade.

entries.conclusion: The same fresh-wakeup observation can be repeated after merge.
entries.does_not_establish: A security attestation or candidate gate.
